messages:
Ashley: Quick sync — Meridian QBR runway for 30 Jun. Using this thread to hand off the playbook + slide owners, surface onboarding gaps, and list renewal risks. I'll post a slide owner map and ask owners to confirm.

Mike: Got it. I'll take account health and metrics slide. Can we add a short note on token usage trend? @Tom please confirm executive ask for commitment level.

Divya: I'll own onboarding status + enablement gaps. I have two customer training sessions missing from our checklist.

Tom: Confirmed. Exec ask: clarity on renewal posture and a recommended one‑pager for the CFO. I can draft the one‑pager once we finalize the risk matrix.

Jenna: I'll capture feedback themes and action items. Will need a call with product to prioritize the top 3 asks.

Ashley: Slide map (proposed):
1) Cover + agenda — Ashley
2) Account health & usage — Mike
3) Onboarding progress & blockers — Divya
4) Enablement plan + training gaps — Divya
5) Renewal risk & recommendation — Tom
6) Feedback themes & product asks — Jenna
7) Next steps & owners — Ashley
Link to deck: https://redwood.workspaces/meridian-qbr-deck (placeholder)

Mike: Confirmed for slide 2. I'll include:
- 90/60/30 day health cadence
- top 5 anomalies (cost, latency, model drift)
- token trend chart (need last 30 days from infra)

Divya: Confirmed slide 3 and 4. Action: compile training attendance + missing modules by Tue 6/18. Also propose a canary enablement session the week before the QBR.

Tom: I'll prepare the renewal risk matrix. Quick ask: what's the committed ARR and current MRR churn signal? @Mike can you paste the numbers?

Mike: Numbers: Committed ARR = $1.2M, MRR run-rate = $100k, churn signal = 2.1% last 30d. (cc @Ashley)

Jenna: I'll synthesize feedback into 3 product asks and prioritize severity. Will open a ticket for product and ping them in #product-feedback.

Ashley: Action items recap (owners + due dates):
- Mike: finalize Slide 2 + token chart — due 6/20
- Divya: onboarding checklist + propose canary session — due 6/18
- Tom: renewal risk matrix + one‑pager draft — due 6/22
- Jenna: feedback themes + product ticket — due 6/19
- Ashley: assemble final deck + rehearsals schedule — due 6/24

deck-bot: Reminder: presentation rehearsal scheduled 2026-06-26 10:00am PT. RSVP by 6/25.

Divya: Quick note — two enablement sessions clash with client holidays; proposing alternate dates in my doc: https://redwood.workspaces/meridian-onboard-schedule

Mike: Small risk flag: KV cache regression last week caused latency spike; I'll include mitigation and impact estimate on Slide 2 (low risk to renewal but measurable).

Tom: Suggest we add a single-slide "ask" for execs: 3 items (extend pilot discount, approve dedicated capacity, commit to product roadmap checkpoint). I'll mock the ask slide and share.

Ashley: Great. If owners agree, I'll lock slides on 6/24 and schedule a dry run 6/26. :thumbsup:

Jenna: +1. I'll coordinate product invite after I file the ticket.

Mike: Done — pushed token chart to deck (slide 2). Small comment added.

End.
